client_yes._note: Second half of a report highlight when a client got the service he asked for.

They slipped away from the crowded lounge while the fiddler was mid-song. By the time the tune ended, the evening had gone somewhere much quieter.
He spent a long, unhurried evening behind a closed door and emerged looking like a man who'd forgotten what day it was. His coin purse, on the other hand, remembered perfectly.
The room smelled of lavender and warm candle wax by the time they were done, and the bedsheets looked like they'd lost an argument.

Her favorite. She was humming afterward.
She came back downstairs smiling.
